Iris Park: Cedar (finance) wants to move off HaloAPI. Request: 3-week POC to validate connector parity, network peering, KMS, and a migration cost delta. Can SE + infra run this?
Omar Reyes: Yes. SE approach: small prompt pack (~60) covering summary, style, troubleshooting, and session continuity. Need sample HaloAPI responses and whether they persist conversation state server-side.
Nina Petrova: I'll own the eval harness and diff reports. Please drop a sample of 100 real-ish requests (anonymized). Also what's their p95 SLO? They said ~200ms in the deck.
Caleb Ortiz: Ops note: we can provide a dedicated dev pool and static egress. Need CIDR and peering window. For KMS BYOK in dev we support envelope encryption.
Iris Park: NDA executed this morning. Dropping their prompt pack inline: 
```
1) "Summarize user feedback and list action items"
2) "Convert to executive bullet points (<=3)"
3) "Troubleshoot DB connection: list 4 checks"
```
Sample HaloAPI response (sanitized):
`{"id":"r007","text":"Restart DB, check replicas","entities":["db","replica"]}`
Omar Reyes: Running first pass. Note: Halo token rounding means short responses look more expensive. We'll report exact vs rounded costs.
Nina Petrova: Adding tokenized diff and semantic-check (intent match) to the harness. Will flag any multi-turn context drift.
Caleb Ortiz: Reserved egress IPs allocated: 3.101.77.10 - 3.101.77.13. Peering slot proposed: 03/27 02:00-04:00 UTC. ops-bot: provisioning queued.
security-bot: Security docs delivered: SOC2 summary, DPA draft, and redacted pen-test. Cedar requested 12mo audit log retention and KMS integration.
Iris Park: Finance ask: estimate token/month. They projected 800k tokens/mo. Lisa from finance will do pricing scenarios and credits.
Omar Reyes: Initial diff run: 60 prompts -> 55 exact after whitespace normalize; 4 minor punctuation diffs; 1 multi-turn where context tokenization shifted entity order. Attaching CSV in drive.
Nina Petrova: Action items: 1) SE finalize diff + token report, 2) Ops complete peering + IP allowlist, 3) Security confirm KMS workflow, 4) Finance produce scenarios. Mid-POC review scheduled Fri 11:00 PT. :calendar:
